paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the paper's xi = (4/3)|E/N - 1.92| via g_agamma = (alpha/(2*pi*f_a)) * (3/4)*xi with f_a[GeV] = 5.7e6 / m_a[eV], i.e. g = 1.528e-10 * xi * m_a[eV] GeV^-1
notes: Telescope search for optical line emission from two-photon decay of thermal relic axions in galaxy clusters Abell 2667 and 2390 (VIMOS IFU at VLT). Null result gives 95% CL upper limits on xi in the mass window 4.5-7.7 eV (Table I). Values converted to g_agamma using standard QCD axion mass-f_a relation (m_a*f_a = 5.7e-3 GeV^2) and g = (alpha/2pi f_a)(3/4)xi; if downstream prefers raw values, the paper's xi limits are: 7.17e-3 (4.5 eV), 9.00e-3 (5), 5.72e-3 (6), 4.60e-3 (6.5), 3.41e-3 (7), 2.95e-3 (7.5), 2.47e-3 (7.65). Limits assume thermal-freezeout cosmological axion abundance (Omega_a h^2 = m_a,eV/130), NOT a local DM halo density, so dm_density_assumed is null. Cross-correlation limits (Table II) are ~1.5x weaker and not included. Masses near 5.43 and 4.83 eV (sky lines at 5577 and 6300 A) are unconstrained.
